# Salt-Seeking Achieved

While I wait for tokens to reset, a musing… blygging feels weird in a zero-gravity way. It’s very social but in a zero-gravity way. There is no planet-like platform. The reference space is just the swarm of other blygs. There is no sense of a platform boundary so in that sense it’s the salt-seeking medium I’ve wanted since I left Wordpress. Even more so actually, since being on WPEngine lowered the salinity of my Wordpress experience.

I wrote about salt-seeking in [Memento Salis](https://contraptions.venkateshrao.com/p/memento-salis) (2025) and [Salt-Seeking](https://ribbonfarm.com/2023/03/01/salt-seeking/) (2023)

This finally scratches a really big old itch.
